maddeler.e:
نلتمس (form VIII)
# نَلْتَمِسُ (naltamisu) /nal.ta.mi.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# نُلْتَمَسُ (nultamasu) /nul.ta.ma.su/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# نَلْتَمِسَ (naltamisa) /nal.ta.mi.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# نُلْتَمَسَ (nultamasa) /nul.ta.ma.sa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
